well.name: CNRL 1B HZ KENT 1-28-60-2
well.well_notes:
Surface:
- Spudded 375mm surface hole with water, allowing the native clays to build viscosity.
- SCP @ 156m. Circulated and increased viscosity to 39s/L for wiper trip.
- Wiper tripped, back reaming as needed. Viscosity at 45s/L once back on bottom.
- Circulated and increased viscosity to 70s/L with Bentonite and Zan HD for casing.
- Circulated hole clean and pulled out for casing.
- Ran 298.4mm casing to bottom in 1hr with no problems.
- Cemented casing with 8m3 good cement returns.

Intermediate:
- Drilled out cement with water.
- Drilled a 270mm top hole with Floc Water, mudding up to a Polymer system at 350m.
- Wiper tripped @ 500m with a viscosity of 45s/L. No issues reported on trip.
- ICP @ 631m. Circulated and wiper tripped with no issues and no fill reported.
- Circulated hole clean and increased viscosity to 75s/L. Pulled out for casing.
- Ran 219.1mm casing to bottom in 4hr with no problems reported.
- Circulated, reducing viscosity to 45s/L and pumped abrasive sweep. 
- Cemented with 5m3 full weight scavenger returns and 0.5m3 @ 1800m3.

Lateral:
- Drilled 12, 200mm lateral legs with an Amine Polymer system.
- Displaced legs to fresh, premixed Polymer with an additional 2L/m3 Bleach added prior to displacing.
- Part way through the lateral, they began utilizing fresh water instead of produced water.
- Downtime on leg #8 @ 1361m for Rig Repair.
- Added lubricant on leg #9 at 1270m to aid with sliding.
- After displacing leg #9, back reamed to 630m and spotted Accretion pill (10L/m3 Targone, 5L/m3 UniCoat, 5kg/m3 SAPP). Allowed Accretion pill to soak while pulling out of the hole and waiting on rig repairs.
- Performed scraper run and picked up tools.
- RIH, had difficulty orienting for leg #10. Tripped to replace directional tools.
- Added Canola Oil and Elixir to help kick off for leg #11.
- Added lubricants (Canola Oil, Arklube 1002, Elixir, and Nut Shell M) as needed.
- At TD of leg #12, circulated until shakers were clean. Back reamed out of the hole to ICP.
- Pumped 7m3 Sweep with Bitubust, UniCoat and Targone.
- Ran 114.3mm liner to 1200m and it would not go any further.
- Laid down some liner and ran back in to 1150m. Set liner and displaced top section to fresh water.
- Ran and set bridge plug.

notes.summary:
June 21:
Skid rig to 1B HZ KENT 1-28-60-02
notes.recommendation:
Please ensure all tanks have no reisude from previous lateral prior to adding any chemical for drilling surface, 
Spud in with fresh water with no additions.

USE GEL for Viscosity building at TD if required can add 1/2 sx of ZAN HD to ensure vis is 80 s/l+

Maintenance: 
- Density should be maintained as low as possible utilizing all solids control + fresh water for dilution.
 - pH should be maintained below 7.0 to minimize the possibility of mud rings. 
-Citric Acid may be added over suction via chem bbl. to help lower the pH- Citric Acid additions should be made at 1 vis cup every connection. 
Do not over treat with dispersants  as increasing Viscosity maybe required.
 - Sawdust can be added at 2 - 4 sacks per Kelly down. 
-Allow bottoms up circulations between connections to reduce accumulation of solids in the annulus. 

Casing + Cement:
 - Increase the viscosity for wiper trip to 50+ s/L with Gel. Once Wiper trip is over make sure vis is 80 s/l+- for running casing if needed add 1/2 sx of ZAN HD.

- Prior to cementing lower the viscosity to 40 - 45 s/L with additions of Desco CF and stripped water for dilution.

Once cemented strip back all fluid to use on top hole section by injecting GAF-A245 andadditions of Calcium Chloride Powder

notes.recommendation:
Floc Water:
  * Clean tanks from the previous section and fill with treated produced water.
  * Add 3-4 sacks Calcium Chloride Powder to achieve an initial calcium concentration.
  * Drill out cement with active system isolated to 
lowering the pH with 3-4 sacks Citric Acid if required.
   
Maintenance:
  * Allow the pH to remain neutral or <8 to prevent shales from hydrating and to prevent mud rings.
  * Control the calcium concentration with tourly additions of Calcium Chloride Powder to maintain 800 - 1200mg/L.
  * Add GAF-A245 with injection tank to clarify the water. If the water becomes cloudy, increase GAF-A245 additions or mix a circulation of Calcium Chloride Powder.
Maintenance:
  * Allow the pH to remain neutral or <8 to prevent shales from hydrating and to prevent mud rings.
  * Control the calcium concentration with tourly additions of Calcium Chloride Powder to maintain 800 - 1200mg/L.
  * Add GAF-A245 with injection tank to clarify the water. If the water becomes cloudy, increase GAF-A245 additions or mix a circulation of Calcium Chloride Powder.
   
Mud Rings:
  * Add 2 - 3 sacks Sawdust per single while drilling.
  * If a mud ring is suspected SAPP/Drill Detergent can also be used to facilitate mud ring dispersion.
  * Monitor the well for cleaning at the shaker as well as pressure increases so mud rings can be detected early.

Mud Up: +/- 385m Once through Colony/Mclaren
  * Mud up on the fly to a Polymer system. Ensure fluid system is mudded up prior to any trips.
  * Discontinue Calcium Chloride Powder additions and allow it to deplete naturally.
  * Mix 2 sacks each UniPAC HVD, UniSTAR and 6 sacks Lignite/Humalite for initial mud up.
   
Maintenance:
  * Maintain the viscosity 40 s/L by mixing Fusion and UniPAC HVD in a 1:1 ratio as required.
  * Maintain the density with solids control equipment, fine mesh shaker screens and centrifuge.
  * Maintain fluid loss 8-10cc/30 min with UniPAC HVD, UniSTAR, and Lignite/Humalite in a 1:1:4 ratio.
  * Continue to add Sawdust on connections to efficiently clean the bit and prevent mud rings.

40 s/l for Wiper trip with ZAN HD/UniPAC HVD 1-1 over a circ please ensure it goes in evenly and to take a vis at the end of the circ. 

Raise vis to 55-60 s/l for TD with ZAN HD/UniPAC HVD 1-1 over a circ please ensure it goes in evenly and to take a vis at the end of the circ.

notes.recommendation:
Please ensure all tanks have no reisude from previous lateral prior to adding any chemical for drilling surface, 
Spud in with fresh water with no additions.

USE GEL for Viscosity building at TD if required can add 1/2 sx of ZAN HD to ensure vis is 80 s/l+

Maintenance: 
- Density should be maintained as low as possible utilizing all solids control + fresh water for dilution.
 - pH should be maintained 7.0 or under to minimize the possibility of mud rings. 
-Citric Acid may be added over suction via chem bbl. to help lower the pH- Citric Acid additions should be made at 1 vis cup every connection. 
Do not over treat with dispersants  as increasing Viscosity maybe required.
 - Sawdust can be added at 2 - 4 sacks per Kelly down. 
-Allow bottoms up circulations between connections to reduce accumulation of solids in the annulus. 

Casing + Cement:
 - Increase the viscosity for wiper trip to 50+ s/L with Gel. Once Wiper trip is over make sure vis is 50 - 80 sec/L  for running casing if needed add 1/2 sx of ZAN HD (** As per Co men Requests)

- Prior to cementing lower the viscosity to 40 - 45 sec/L with additions of Desco CF and stripped water for dilution.

Once cemented strip back all fluid to use on top hole section by injecting GAF-A245 and additions of Calcium Chloride Powder
